title: Interstellar
description: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival amid a dying Earth, facing time dilation and sacrifice.

title: The Martian
description: An astronaut becomes stranded on Mars and must find a way to survive using ingenuity, science, and sheer willpower while awaiting rescue.

title: Inception
description: A skilled thief who steals secrets through dream-sharing technology is given a chance to erase his criminal history by planting an idea into a target's subconscious.

title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman faces a criminal mastermind known as the Joker, who unleashes chaos on Gotham City, testing the hero's moral limits.

title: 3 Idiots
description: Three engineering students navigate friendship, pressure, and the flawed education system while chasing their true passions in life.

title: Dangal
description: A former wrestler trains his daughters to become world-class wrestlers, challenging gender norms in rural India.

title: The Matrix
description: A computer hacker learns that reality is a simulation controlled by machines and joins a rebellion to free humanity.

title: Avengers: Endgame
description: Earth's mightiest heroes assemble one final time to undo the destruction caused by a powerful villain, using time travel and sacrifice.

title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
description: Three friends embark on a road trip across Spain, confronting personal fears and rediscovering the meaning of friendship and life.

title: Gravity
description: An astronaut and a medical engineer struggle to survive after debris destroys their space shuttle, leaving them stranded in orbit.
